title: fix(types): name the field when an organization-scoped unique value is duplicated
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DGbYtBuWsC7Di21QvAEvcTn)_
Fixes #32711
Clause-②: yes (widening) — `@objectstack/types` newly exports `uniqueViolationField`, and a `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION` for a duplicate in an organization-scoped unique field now carries `field` (and the engine envelope `fieldLabel`) where it carried none; nothing existing is removed, retyped or refused, and `uniqueViolationColumn` answers exactly as before.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:按组织唯一的字段(`unique: 'organization'` 或 `unique: true`)录入重复值时,服务端的 409 `UNIQUE_VIOLATION` 现在会带上字段名 `field` 和显示名 `fieldLabel`,表单顶部的句子从「A record with this value already exists」变成「A record with this 发票号码 already exists」,前端也能把错误挂到那个输入框上。
- 为什么改:这类字段在数据库里是「组织 + 字段」两列的组合唯一索引,服务端原来对所有组合键一律不报字段;组织那一列是平台自动填的范围,用户真正重复输入的只有另一列,所以可以确定地报出来。
- 风险与回滚:新增了一个只给拒绝提示用的判断 `uniqueViolationField`,原来的 `uniqueViolationColumn` 一字未动,自动编号重试仍用旧判断,行为不变(首版曾直接改旧判断,会让同一批里另一个组织白烧一个编号,已改掉并有测试钉住)。两列及以上的自定义组合索引、租户列不叫 `organization_id` 的对象、MySQL、旧的 COALESCE 表达式索引照旧不报字段。回滚即 revert 本 PR,不涉及数据。
- 先看:`packages/types/src/unique-violation.ts` 的 `soleColumn` 与新导出 `uniqueViolationField`,再看 `packages/objectql/src/duplicate-record-error.ts` 和 `packages/types/src/data-error-classification.ts` 中改用新导出的两行。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/types exec vitest run src/unique-violation.test.ts`,预期 55 条全部通过,其中「uniqueViolationField — the implied organization key part is set aside」一组 11 条。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

A field declared `unique: 'organization'` (or `unique: true`) is enforced by the composite index `(organization_id, FIELD)` (ADR-0120 D3, keyed plain since ADR-0131 D1). The database reports a duplicate as `UNIQUE constraint failed: t.organization_id, t.invoice_no` (SQLite) or `Key (organization_id, invoice_no)=(…)` (Postgres). Every multi-column key named no column, so the `409 UNIQUE_VIOLATION` answer carried no `field` and the form could only say "A record with this value already exists".

- **`packages/types/src/unique-violation.ts`:** a new export, `uniqueViolationField`, answers "which field does this refusal name": the column `uniqueViolationColumn` would name, except that the implied organization key part (`organization_id`) is set aside first. The organization part is the scope the platform stamps from the writer's organization, never a value the user typed, so naming the other column is not a guess. Unchanged under it: a key of more than one authored column (`organization_id, department, code`, or `tenant_id, email`) names none; a key whose only part is `organization_id` names that column; index names (MySQL, SQLite's `index 'x'`, Postgres' constraint name) and expressions (the legacy `COALESCE(organization_id, '__global__')` part) name none. Only `organization_id` is set aside: an object whose `tenancy.tenantField` names another column keys on that column, which the driver's text cannot tell from an authored one.
- **`uniqueViolationColumn` is unchanged, on purpose.** The autonumber retry (`collidingAutoNumberReservations` in driver-sql, `isIssuedAutonumberCollision` in objectql) reads a named column as "every reservation on this field collided". In a batch spanning two organizations the column cannot say which organization's counter collided, and the composite `undefined` is what sends the retry to its per-row data probe. A first version of this PR widened `uniqueViolationColumn` itself; the driver-sql suite went red (`re-seeds only the counter that went stale, leaving a co-tenant in the same batch alone`: the co-tenant burned a number), and the seat ruled for the split (Acceptance notes).
- **The two refusal branches read the new export:** the engine envelope (`envelopeUniqueViolation`, `packages/objectql/src/duplicate-record-error.ts`) now carries `field` and resolves `fieldLabel` in the writer's locale, so the `DuplicateRecordError` arm of `mapDataError` answers "A record with this Invoice Number already exists" with `field: 'invoice_no'`; the raw driver arm of `mapDataError` carries `field` with the unnamed sentence, as it does for any single column. The doc comments of both say so.
- The language of `userMessage` is not touched (the localized-text program owns it).

## Tests

- `packages/types/src/unique-violation.test.ts`, new describe "uniqueViolationField — the implied organization key part is set aside": the SQLite sentence the defect was measured on, verbatim; the Postgres `detail` channel; the organization part in either position; a key whose only part is `organization_id`; single-column keys answer as `uniqueViolationColumn` does; `uniqueViolationColumn` still names no column for the same composite (the routing invariant); and the controls that name none (organization + two authored columns on both dialects, two authored columns, a scope column other than `organization_id`, the legacy COALESCE expression part).
- `packages/rest/src/rest-unique-violation-dialects.test.ts`: four samples in the dialect table (an organization-scoped field, and organization + two authored columns, on SQLite and Postgres), driven through all three faces (predicate, wire envelope, `field`).
- `packages/objectql/src/engine-duplicate-record-label-sentence.test.ts`, new describe over the four write doors (insert, batch insert, update by id, update by predicate): `field`, `fieldLabel` and the HTTP sentence name the field by label, the `zh-CN` label in the writer's locale, and the two-authored-column control.
- The driver-sql autonumber suites are untouched and green (10 files), which is the proof the routing did not move.
- The consumers that pinned the old no-field answer through real stacks now pin the new one: the rest data-package control (`field: 'code'`), the runtime dispatcher and sandbox-relay wire-code suites (`details.field: 'email'`), the dogfood boot (`field: 'sku'`, "A record with this SKU already exists"), and the verify unique-scope family (`uqs_account.name` is credited by its named field, no twin needed).

## Acceptance notes

- **Seat rulings (domain:server#8), recorded here as accepted deviations.** (1) The first version widened `uniqueViolationColumn` and re-pinned two driver-sql pins under a seat-approved surface addition; the full driver-sql suite then showed the co-tenant regression above. (2) The seat then ruled for the split: a new `uniqueViolationField` export for the refusals, `uniqueViolationColumn` and the autonumber routing unchanged, the driver-sql test file restored byte-identical and dropped from the surface, and the public-surface widening declared on the `Clause-②:` line (level stays patch, `Metadata-protocol: none`). (3) The seat then approved six consumer test files onto the surface, because they pinned the old no-field answer this card changes: `packages/rest/src/data-package-scoped-refusal-candidates.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-unique-violation-wire-code.test.ts`, `packages/runtime/src/sandbox-relay-unique-violation-wire-code.test.ts`, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/field-unique-rest-refusal.dogfood.test.ts`, `packages/qa/dogfood/test/error-sentences-live.dogfood.test.ts`, `packages/verify/src/unique-scope.test.ts`; plus the attribution comment in `packages/verify/src/unique-scope.ts`, which this change made false (comment only, `'@objectstack/verify': patch`). The whole claim was re-posted each time; the governing one is comment 6838469816.
- **The verify attribution control was reshaped, not weakened.** Its `uqa_tagged` fixture made its field-less refusal with a second organization-scoped unique field (`code`), which now names `code` and would have moved the control onto the "constraint on another field" branch. It now collides on a unique `indexes[]` entry over two authored columns `(code, kind)`, both stamped by the hook, so the no-field + twin-refused path keeps live coverage; no assertion was removed (13/13 green).
- The `packages/qa/dogfood` edits are test-only follow-through of this card's behaviour (`domain:devx` files, no source).
- **Kept the old answer, by surface (for the seat to judge whether a card is owed):** the trash restore's `RESTORE_UNIQUE_VALUE_TAKEN` (`packages/objectql/src/recycle-bin/restore.ts`) still asks `uniqueViolationColumn`. reach: restoring a recycle-bin entry whose organization-scoped unique value another live row now holds answers "another record now holds a value it must keep unique (a unique value)" with no `field`, where it could name the field. The import runner is not affected: its row sentence is the unnamed one for every column, and an engine refusal reaches it through the envelope, which now carries `field`.
- Still no `field` (unchanged, each by the same "a wrong field name is worse than none" contract): a database still carrying the pre-ADR-0131 `COALESCE(organization_id, '__global__')` expression index, MySQL, objects whose `tenancy.tenantField` is not `organization_id`, and driver-memory, whose refusal is worded in its own sentence rather than a dialect's.
- The console renders a localized per-field message from `field` (`FormPage.tsx`); that rendering, if wanted, is the `domain:ui` follow-up the card names, not this PR.
- Serial note from the seat: #32590 claims driver-sql schema-sync/drift files; this PR no longer touches driver-sql.

## Verification

Head 04634c890634f321aeee37de9a4986a424361471 (origin/main merged once, at 682067857, before the PR opened).

<details><summary>Premise: the real SQLite refusal on the index the driver builds today</summary>

`packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver-autonumber-resync.test.ts` (on `main`, untouched here) builds `crm_case` with `initObjects` (an `organization_id` column and `case_number` declared `unique: true`), reads the index back as ``(`organization_id`, `case_number`)`` with no `COALESCE`, inserts a duplicate through better-sqlite3 and gets `UNIQUE constraint failed: crm_case.organization_id, crm_case.case_number`, the card's measured shape, with `uniqueViolationColumn` answering `undefined`. `uniqueViolationField` answers `case_number` on that sentence (`unique-violation.test.ts`).
</details>
